title: Tropical Storm Isaias Hurricane Watch: Latest Forecast and How to Listen Live
summary: Get the latest Tropical Storm Isaias forecasts and updates live on FOX Weather.
body_markdown:
Tropical Storm Isaias has formed in the southern Gulf of Mexico and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane before making landfall along the northern Gulf Coast later this week.


[FOX Weather Your home for weather news Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-FOXWeather)


As the storm approaches, listen to[FOX Weather (Ch. 799)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/fox-weather) on SiriusXM for the latest forecasts and updates on Isaias, including potential storm surge, flash flooding, damaging winds, tornadoes, and the storm’s expected path and timing.


### **How to Listen to Tropical Storm Isaias Updates**


Listen to FOX Weather (Ch. 799) for 24/7 weather news, the latest forecasts, live reports from the field, and expert analysis as Tropical Depression Edouard approaches the Gulf Coast.


FOX Weather is available on SiriusXM Ch. 799 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-FOXWeather) .
